En el corazón del libro hay una sección de referencia de 200 páginas titulada "Windows XP Applications and Tools", que contiene:

Información detallada sobre la mayoría de los comandos y utilidades disponibles con Windows XP, incluyendo accesorios de menú de inicio, herramientas rápidas de comando, utilidades de administración de sistemas ocultas como el Editor de Registro, Microsoft Management Console y TweakUI.

Una sección completa "¿Dónde encontrarlo?" diseñada para dar a los usuarios de Windows 9x/Me y Windows NT/2000 una guía de los contrapartes XP a características previamente familiares, más información sobre la instalación y actualización.

El índice de tareas y configuración, que proporciona a los usuarios acceso rápido a los lugares de los cientos de ajustes en Windows XP, organizado alfabéticamente.

Una referencia completa al impulso de comandos, no sólo cubriendo los fundamentos de la línea de comandos y las diferentes maneras de utilizarlo, sino también los comandos avanzados y funciones de scripting a disposición de Windows XP.

Empaquetado con numerosos consejos y trucos, mientras que la advertencia de posibles trampas, Windows XP en un Nutshell permite a cualquiera sacar el máximo provecho de todos los recursos disponibles en XP.

title: Pro Android Apps Performance Optimization
description:
Today's Android apps developers are often running into the need to refine, improve and optimize their apps performances. As more complex apps can be created, it is even more important for developers to deal with this critical issue.

Android allows developers to write apps using Java, C or a combination of both with the Android SDK and the Android NDK. Pro Android Apps Performance Optimization reveals how to fine-tune your Android apps, making them more stable and faster. In this book, you'll learn the following:

How to optimize your Java code with the SDK, but also how to write and optimize native code using advanced features of the Android NDK such as using ARM single instruction multiple data (SIMD) instructions (in C or assembly)

How to use multithreading in your application, how make best use of memory and how to maximize battery life

How to use to some OpenGL optimizations and to Renderscript, a new feature in Android 3.0 (Honeycomb) and expanded in Android 4.0 (Ice Cream Sandwich).

After reading and using this book, you'll be a better coder and your apps will be better-coded. Better-performing apps mean better reviews and eventually, more money for you as the app developer or your indie shop.

What you'll learn

How to optimize your applications in Java

How to optimize your applications using the NDK

How to best use memory to maximize performance

How to maximize battery life

How and when to use multi-threading

How to benchmark and profile your code

How to optimize OpenGL code and use Renderscript

Who this book is for

Android developers already familiar with Java and Android SDK, who want to go one step further and learn how to maximize performance.
translatedDescription:
Los desarrolladores de aplicaciones Android de hoy a menudo están corriendo en la necesidad de refinar, mejorar y optimizar sus rendimientos de aplicaciones. A medida que se pueden crear aplicaciones más complejas, es aún más importante que los desarrolladores se ocupen de este problema crítico.

Android permite a los desarrolladores escribir aplicaciones usando Java, C o una combinación de ambos con el SDK Android y el NDK Android. Pro Android Apps Optimización de rendimiento revela cómo ajustar sus aplicaciones Android, haciéndolos más estables y más rápidos. En este libro aprenderás lo siguiente:

Cómo optimizar su código Java con el SDK, pero también cómo escribir y optimizar el código nativo utilizando características avanzadas del NDK Android, tales como el uso de instrucciones individuales de instrucciones múltiples datos (SIMD) (en C o montaje)

Cómo utilizar multithreading en su aplicación, cómo hacer el mejor uso de la memoria y cómo maximizar la vida de la batería

Cómo utilizar algunas optimizaciones OpenGL y Renderscript, una nueva característica en Android 3.0 (Honeycomb) y expandido en Android 4.0 (Ice Cream Sandwich).

Después de leer y usar este libro, serás un mejor codificador y tus aplicaciones serán mejor codificadas. Las aplicaciones que mejor funcionan significan mejores críticas y eventualmente, más dinero para usted como el desarrollador de aplicaciones o su tienda indie.

Lo que aprenderás

Cómo optimizar sus aplicaciones en Java

Cómo optimizar sus aplicaciones usando el NDK

Cómo utilizar mejor la memoria para maximizar el rendimiento

Cómo maximizar la vida de la batería

Cómo y cuándo utilizar multi-threading

Cómo valorar y perfilar su código

Cómo optimizar código OpenGL y utilizar Renderscript

Para quién es este libro

Android desarrolladores ya familiarizados con Java y Android SDK, que quieren ir un paso más allá y aprender cómo maximizar el rendimiento.

title: Beginning SharePoint Communication Sites: Creating and Managing Professional Collaborative Experiences
description:
Understand SharePoint communication sites and create one on your own using SharePoint Home available in Office 365. This beginner's book will advise you about the ways to integrate your existing collaboration channels with SharePoint communication sites. Along the way you will see how to embed documents, videos, and real-time data from across Office 365, including documents from SharePoint, Power BI reports, Microsoft Stream videos, and Yammer discussions. 
The author starts by giving an introduction to SharePoint communication sites and how to create them. Next, you’ll cover various cases to understand the benefits of communicating through SharePoint communications sites. Further, you will learn how to design collaborative experiences for end users along with ways to plan social intranets. Here, you will understand how to integrate Yammer, SharePoint Online and email in order to build a collaborative experience. You will then integrate communication siteswith Office 365 products for better end user collaboration. Finally, you will discover how to plan for and create communities using communication sites and learn more about social knowledge management.
After reading Beginning SharePoint Communication Sites, you will be able to create and manage SharePoint communication sites and improve ways to communicate and collaborate within your organization.
 
What You Will Learn
Create SharePoint communication sites to share information with larger and smaller groups
Enrich the end-user experience while sharing information with a bigger audience 
Plan digital intranets using SharePoint communication sites
Design visually compelling intranets
Transform the way you share information within your company
Dynamically pull in and display data, documents, and information via web parts
Integrate with Yammer and emails to create collaborative user experiences
Who This Book Is For
IT workers who use SharePoint and are involved in internal communication management, evangelism, digital transformation, social media, and intranet design.
translatedDescription:
Comprende sitios de comunicación SharePoint y cree uno por su cuenta usando SharePoint Home disponible en Office 365. Este libro de principiantes le aconsejará sobre las formas de integrar sus canales de colaboración existentes con los sitios de comunicación de SharePoint. A lo largo de la forma usted verá cómo incrustar documentos, videos y datos en tiempo real de todo Office 365, incluyendo documentos de SharePoint, informes de Power BI, videos de Microsoft Stream y discusiones de Yammer.
El autor comienza dando una introducción a los sitios de comunicación SharePoint y cómo crearlos. A continuación, cubrirá varios casos para comprender los beneficios de la comunicación a través de sitios de comunicaciones SharePoint. Además, aprenderás a diseñar experiencias colaborativas para usuarios finales junto con formas de planificar intranets sociales. Aquí, usted entenderá cómo integrar Yammer, SharePoint Online y correo electrónico para construir una experiencia de colaboración. Luego integrará los sitios de comunicación con los productos Office 365 para mejorar la colaboración del usuario final. Por último, descubrirá cómo planificar y crear comunidades utilizando sitios de comunicación y conocer más acerca de la gestión del conocimiento social.
Después de leer Inicio Sitios de Comunicación SharePoint, podrá crear y gestionar sitios de comunicación SharePoint y mejorar las formas de comunicarse y colaborar dentro de su organización.

Qué aprenderás
Crear sitios de comunicación SharePoint para compartir información con grupos más grandes y pequeños
Enriquecer la experiencia de usuario final al compartir información con un público más grande
Planifique intranets digitales utilizando sitios de comunicación SharePoint
Diseño visualmente convincente intranets
Transforma la forma en que compartes información dentro de tu empresa
Activar y mostrar datos, documentos e información a través de partes web
Integrar con Yammer y correos electrónicos para crear experiencias de usuario colaborativas
Quién es este libro
Los trabajadores de TI que utilizan SharePoint y están involucrados en la gestión interna de la comunicación, evangelismo, transformación digital, redes sociales y diseño intranet.

title: Windows® 7 Bible
description:
This comprehensive reference by a Microsoft expert covers all aspects of the new Windows release

The much-anticipated release of Windows 7 will have numerous changes, and you'll need a complete guide to take full advantage of all it has to offer. Windows 7 Bible covers navigation changes such as pinning to the task bar, full screen preview with invisible windows, Jump Lists, Home Group, Sticky Notes, and many others. It shows you how to use Internet Explorer 8, including features like Web Slices and Network view changes, and guides you through all the new desktop features.

This reference thoroughly examines all three parts of the new platform: Windows 7 Core OS, the Windows Live applications, and Windows Live Services. Windows 7 Bible shows you everything you need to know to make the most of Microsoft's new operating system.

Covers Windows Live Essentials, including Windows Live Family Safety, Mail, Messenger, Movie Maker, Photo Gallery, Toolbar, Writer, and Microsoft Office Outlook Connector

Shows how to use Windows Live Services, including Hotmail and Spaces

Explores new features including Desktop Gadgets Gallery, Desktop Windows manager, updated Fax and DVD Maker, an updated "Devices and Printers" option, and Sticky Notes

Explains new features in the Calculator, ribbon features in applets such as Paint and WordPad, the new Media Center, and searching updates

Fully covers the first complete overhaul of applets in a decade

With Windows 7 Bible at your side, you can learn as much or as little as you need to know for the way you use Windows.
translatedDescription:
Esta referencia integral de un experto de Microsoft cubre todos los aspectos de la nueva versión de Windows

La versión muy anticipada de Windows 7 tendrá numerosos cambios, y necesitará una guía completa para aprovechar plenamente todo lo que tiene que ofrecer. La Biblia de Windows 7 cubre los cambios de navegación tales como la fijación a la barra de tareas, vista previa de pantalla completa con ventanas invisibles, Listas de saltos, Grupo de inicio, Notas pegajosas, y muchos otros. Le muestra cómo utilizar Internet Explorer 8, incluyendo características como Cosas Web y Cambios de Vista de Red, y le guía a través de todas las nuevas funciones de escritorio.

Esta referencia examina a fondo las tres partes de la nueva plataforma: Windows 7 Core OS, las aplicaciones Windows Live y Windows Live Services. Windows 7 La Biblia le muestra todo lo que necesita saber para aprovechar al máximo el nuevo sistema operativo de Microsoft.

Cubre Windows Live Essentials, incluyendo Windows Live Family Safety, Mail, Messenger, Movie Maker, Photo Gallery, Toolbar, Writer y Microsoft Office Outlook Connector

Muestra cómo utilizar Windows Live Services, incluyendo Hotmail y Spaces

Explora nuevas características incluyendo la Galería de Gadgets de Escritorio, el administrador de Windows de escritorio, actualizado Fax y DVD Maker, una opción actualizada "Dispositivos e impresoras" y Sticky Notes

Explica nuevas características en la Calculadora, características de cinta en applets como Paint y WordPad, el nuevo Media Center y actualizaciones de búsqueda

Completamente cubre la primera revisión completa de los applets en una década

Con la Biblia de Windows 7 a tu lado, puedes aprender tanto o tan poco como necesites saber por la forma en que usas Windows.

title: Microsoft® Windows® XP Inside Out, 2nd Edition
description: Take your Windows XP knowledge to the next level! Designed for advanced home and office users, this thoroughly updated second edition delivers in-depth information on core and advanced Windows XP topics, including all-new coverage of Windows XP Service Pack 2, Microsoft Windows Server 2003, Microsoft Windows XP Media Center Edition, Windows Media Series 9, and Windows Movie Maker 2. The award-winning Inside Out format makes it easy to find the timesaving solutions, troubleshooting tips, and workarounds you needand it features new Reality Check sidebars, which offer the straight scoop on popular wisdom about Windows XP.
translatedDescription: ¡Llévese el conocimiento de Windows XP al siguiente nivel! Diseñado para usuarios avanzados de casa y oficina, esta segunda edición completamente actualizada ofrece información detallada sobre temas básicos y avanzados de Windows XP, incluyendo una nueva cobertura de Windows XP Service Pack 2, Microsoft Windows Server 2003, Microsoft Windows XP Media Center Edition, Windows Media Series 9, y Windows Movie Maker 2. El galardonado formato Inside Out hace que sea fácil encontrar las soluciones de tiempos, consejos de solución de problemas y soluciones de trabajo que necesita y cuenta con nuevas barras laterales Reality Check, que ofrecen el scoop derecho en la sabiduría popular sobre Windows XP.

title: SharePoint 2013 For Dummies
description:
The bestselling guide on running SharePoint, now updated to cover all the new features of SharePoint 2013

SharePoint Portal Server is an essential part of the enterprise infrastructure for many businesses. Building on the success of previous versions of SharePoint For Dummies, this new edition covers all the latest features of SharePoint 2013 and provides you with an easy-to-understand resource for making the most of all that this version has to offer. You'll learn how to get a site up and running, branded, and populated with content, workflow, and management. In addition, this new edition includes essential need-to-know information for administrators, techsumers, and page admins who want to leverage the cloud-hosted features online, either as a standalone product or in conjunction with an existing SharePoint infrastructure.

Walks you through getting a SharePoint site up and running effectively and efficiently

Explains ongoing site management and offers plenty of advice for administrators who want to leverage SharePoint and Office 365 in various ways

Shows how to use SharePoint to leverage data centers and collaborate with both internal and external customers, including partners and clients

SharePoint 2013 For Dummies is essential reading if you want to make the most of this technology.
translatedDescription:
La guía de bestselling para ejecutar SharePoint, ahora actualizada para cubrir todas las nuevas características de SharePoint 2013

SharePoint Portal Server es una parte esencial de la infraestructura empresarial para muchas empresas. Basándose en el éxito de versiones anteriores de SharePoint For Dummies, esta nueva edición cubre todas las últimas características de SharePoint 2013 y le proporciona un recurso fácil de entender para aprovechar al máximo todo lo que esta versión tiene que ofrecer. Aprenderás a crear un sitio en funcionamiento, marca y poblado con contenido, flujo de trabajo y gestión. Además, esta nueva edición incluye información necesaria para conocer a administradores, tecnificadores y administradores de páginas que quieren aprovechar las características anfitrionas de la nube en línea, ya sea como un producto independiente o conjuntamente con una infraestructura SharePoint existente.

Camina a través de conseguir un sitio SharePoint funcionando de manera eficaz y eficiente

Explica la gestión del sitio en curso y ofrece un montón de consejos para los administradores que quieren aprovechar SharePoint y Office 365 de varias maneras

Muestra cómo utilizar SharePoint para aprovechar los centros de datos y colaborar con clientes internos y externos, incluidos socios y clientes

SharePoint 2013 Para Dummies es la lectura esencial si desea aprovechar al máximo esta tecnología.

title: My iPad for Seniors, 8th Edition
description:
Covers all iPads running iOS 14.

Easy, clear, readable, and focused on what you want to do. Full-color, step-by-step tasks walk you through getting and keeping your iPad working just the way you want.

Learn how to:

Wirelessly connect to and browse the Internet, at home or away

Video chat with your friends using FaceTime over Wi-Fi or cellular

Make your iPad easier to use if you have trouble seeing or tapping the screen

Use Siris voice commands to control your iPad and find useful information

Communicate with friends and family via email, text messaging, and FaceTime video chats

Shoot, share, and view photos and videos

Listen to streaming music and watch streaming movies and TV shows online

Find locations and get directions using the new Maps app

Use iCloud to store and share your photos and other important data online

Troubleshoot common iPad problems

Cubre todos los iPads que ejecutan iOS 14.

Fácil, claro, legible y enfocado en lo que quieres hacer. Las tareas completas de color, paso a paso te llevan a través de conseguir y mantener tu iPad trabajando de la manera que quieras.

Aprende cómo:

Conexión inalámbrica a Internet y navegar por Internet, en casa o lejos

Video chat con tus amigos usando FaceTime sobre Wi-Fi o celular

Haga su iPad más fácil de usar si tiene problemas para ver o tocar la pantalla

Utilice comandos de voz Siris para controlar su iPad y encontrar información útil

Comuníquese con amigos y familiares por correo electrónico, mensajería de texto y chats de video FaceTime

Disparar, compartir y ver fotos y videos

Escuchar transmitir música y ver películas de streaming y programas de TV en línea

Encontrar ubicaciones y obtener direcciones utilizando la nueva aplicación Maps

Utilice iCloud para almacenar y compartir sus fotos y otros datos importantes en línea

Problemas comunes del iPad

title: The Core iOS Developer’s Cookbook, Fifth Edition
description:
The best place to start iOS application developmentThe Core iOS Developer’s Cookbook provides ready-to-use code solutions for common iOS challenges, providing recipes that help you master the core technology at the heart of iOS. Renowned iOS programming expert Erica Sadun and top iOS developer Rich Wardwell cover the topics you need to create successful mobile applications that take full advantage of iOS graphics, touches, and views. As in all of Sadun’s iOS bestsellers, The Core iOS Developer’s Cookbook translates modern best practices into working code, distilling key concepts into concise recipes you can easily understand and apply to your own projects. This isn’t just cut-and-paste; using examples, Sadun and Wardwell fully explain both the “how” and “why” that underscore effective and successful iOS development. Coverage includes

Creating direct touch-based interfaces with multi-touch, gestures, and custom gesture recognizers

Building and customizing controls in powerful ways

Adding novel motion effects

Alerting users via pop-ups, progress bars, local notifications, popovers, audio cues, and more

Using Xcode modules to easily integrate system frameworks and headers

Assembling views and animation, organizing view hierarchies, and understanding how views work together

Supporting multiple screen geometries with the breakthrough Auto Layout constraints system

Controlling keyboards, making onscreen elements “text aware,” and efficiently scanning and formatting text

Organizing user workspaces with view controllers

Managing photos, videos, email, and text messages

Leveraging enhanced iOS support for social media activities, including Flickr and Vimeo

Implementing VoiceOver accessibility, including text-to-speech

Getting started with Core Data-managed data stores

Leveraging powerful networking and web services support

Using APIs to enhance the user experience
translatedDescription:
El mejor lugar para iniciar el desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS El Core iOS Developer’s Cookbook ofrece soluciones de código listas para usar para los desafíos comunes de iOS, proporcionando recetas que te ayudan a dominar la tecnología básica en el corazón de iOS. Renombrado experto en programación iOS Erica Sadun y desarrollador de iOS Rich Wardwell cubren los temas que necesita para crear aplicaciones móviles exitosas que aprovechan plenamente los gráficos, toques y vistas de iOS. Como en todos los bestsellers iOS de Sadun, The Core iOS Developer’s Cookbook traduce las mejores prácticas modernas en código de trabajo, destilando conceptos claves en recetas concisas que puedes comprender y aplicar fácilmente a tus propios proyectos. Esto no es sólo cortar y pegar; utilizando ejemplos, Sadun y Wardwell explican completamente tanto el “cómo” como “por qué” que subrayan el desarrollo eficaz y exitoso de iOS. La cobertura incluye

Crear interfaces directas basadas en el tacto con multi-touch, gestos y gestores personalizados

Construcción y personalización de controles de manera poderosa

Añadiendo nuevos efectos de movimiento

Alertar usuarios a través de pop-ups, barras de progreso, notificaciones locales, popovers, audio cues, y más

Utilizando módulos Xcode para integrar fácilmente marcos y encabezados del sistema

Montaje de vistas y animación, organización de jerarquías de vista y comprensión de cómo las vistas trabajan juntas

Soporte de múltiples geometrías de pantalla con el sistema de restricciones Auto Layout de gran avance

Controlar teclados, haciendo que los elementos de pantalla “concientes” y escanear y formatear eficientemente texto

Organizar espacios de trabajo de usuario con controladores de vista

Gestión de fotos, vídeos, correo electrónico y mensajes de texto

Aprovechando el apoyo mejorado a iOS para las actividades de redes sociales, incluyendo Flickr y Vimeo

Aplicación de la accesibilidad VoiceOver, incluyendo texto a palabra

Comenzar con las tiendas de datos gestionadas por Core Data

Aprovechamiento de potentes servicios de redes y web

Utilizando APIs para mejorar la experiencia del usuario

title: Essential iOS Build and Release
description:
Frustrated by the requirements for testing and distributing your iOS app? You’re not alone. This concise book takes you step by step through the maze of certification and provisioning processes that have to happen before, during, and after development. You’ll learn what’s required to sign certificates, test your app on iOS devices, and release the finished product to the App Store.

Whether you’re a developer looking to spend more time coding and less time figuring out how to install your application, or a release engineer responsible for producing reliable builds, this guide will help you successfully navigate the build and release processes for your iOS app.

Get an overview of the iOS Dev Center, including the iOS Provisioning Portal, Member Center, and iTunes Connect
Create your App ID, and generate signing certificates for development and distribution
Manage the provisioning profiles necessary to test your app on iOS devices
Learn common scenarios for iOS Simulator, Ad Hoc, and App Store distribution builds
Automate the process to continuously build, sign, and package your app(s) for distribution
translatedDescription:
Frustrado por los requisitos para probar y distribuir tu aplicación iOS? No estás solo. Este libro conciso le lleva paso a paso a través del laberinto de procesos de certificación y provisión que tienen que suceder antes, durante y después del desarrollo. Usted aprenderá lo que se requiere para firmar certificados, probar su aplicación en dispositivos iOS, y liberar el producto terminado a la App Store.

Si usted es un desarrollador que busca pasar más tiempo de codificación y menos tiempo de averiguar cómo instalar su aplicación, o un ingeniero de liberación responsable de producir construcciones confiables, esta guía le ayudará a navegar con éxito los procesos de construcción y liberación para su aplicación iOS.

Obtenga una visión general del Centro iOS Dev, incluyendo el Portal de Suministros iOS, el Centro de Miembros y iTunes Connect
Crear su ID de aplicación y generar certificados de firma para el desarrollo y la distribución
Gestione los perfiles de provisión necesarios para probar su aplicación en dispositivos iOS
Aprende escenarios comunes para iOS Simulator, Ad Hoc y App Store construye distribución
Automatizar el proceso para construir, firmar y empaquetar continuamente sus aplicaciones para su distribución

title: Android Apps for Absolute Beginners
description:
Anybody can start building multimedia apps for the Android platform, and this book will show you how! Now updated to include both Android 4.4 and the new Android 5.0, Android Apps for Absolute Beginners, Third Edition takes you through the process of getting your first Android apps up and running using plain English and practical examples.

This book cuts through the fog of jargon and mystery that surrounds Android apps development, and gives you simple, step-by-step instructions to get you started.

Teaches Android application development in language anyone can understand, giving you the best possible start in Android development
Provides simple, step-by-step examples that make learning easy, allowing you to pick up the concepts without fuss
Offers clear code descriptions and layout so that you can get your apps running as soon as possible

This book covers both Android 4.4 (KitKat) and Android 5.0, but is also backwards compatible to cover the previous Android releases since Android 1.5.
translatedDescription:
Cualquiera puede empezar a crear aplicaciones multimedia para la plataforma Android, y este libro te mostrará cómo! Ahora actualizado para incluir tanto Android 4.4 como el nuevo Android 5.0, Android Apps para Absolute Beginners, Third Edition te lleva a través del proceso de obtener tus primeras aplicaciones Android y ejecutar usando ejemplos simples de inglés y prácticos.

Este libro corta a través de la niebla de la jerga y el misterio que rodea el desarrollo de aplicaciones Android, y le da instrucciones simples paso a paso para comenzar.

Teaches Android desarrollo de aplicaciones en el idioma que alguien puede entender, dándole el mejor comienzo posible en el desarrollo Android
Proporciona ejemplos simples, paso a paso que facilitan el aprendizaje, lo que permite recoger los conceptos sin fusibles
Ofrece descripciones de código claras y diseño para que pueda ejecutar sus aplicaciones lo antes posible

Este libro cubre tanto Android 4.4 (KitKat) como Android 5.0, pero también es compatible con el retroceso para cubrir las versiones anteriores de Android desde Android 1.5.

title: Android Application Development
description:
This practical book provides the concepts and code you need to develop software with Android, the open-source platform for cell phones and mobile devices that's generating enthusiasm across the industry. Based on the Linux operating system and developed by Google and the Open Handset Alliance, Android has the potential to unite a fragmented mobile market. Android Application Development introduces this programming environment, and offers you a complete working example that demonstrates Android architectural features and APIs. With this book, you will:

Get a complete introduction to the Android programming environment, architecture, and tools
Build a modular application, beginning with a core module that serves to launch modules added in subsequent chapters
Learn the concepts and architecture of a specific feature set, including views, maps, location-based services, persistent data storage, 2D and 3D graphics, media services, telephony services, and messaging
Use ready-to-run example code that implements each feature
Delve into advanced topics, such as security, custom views, performance analysis, and internationalization

The book is a natural complement to the existing Android documentation provided by Google. Whether you want to develop a commercial application for mobile devices, or just want to create a mobile mashup for personal use, Android Application Development demonstrates how you can design, build, and test applications for the new mobile market.
translatedDescription:
Este libro práctico proporciona los conceptos y el código que necesita para desarrollar software con Android, la plataforma de código abierto para teléfonos celulares y dispositivos móviles que genera entusiasmo en toda la industria. Basado en el sistema operativo Linux y desarrollado por Google y Open Handset Alliance, Android tiene el potencial de unir un mercado móvil fragmentado. Android Application Development presenta este entorno de programación, y le ofrece un ejemplo de trabajo completo que demuestra características arquitectónicas de Android y APIs. Con este libro, usted:

Obtenga una introducción completa al entorno de programación Android, arquitectura y herramientas
Construir una aplicación modular, comenzando con un módulo básico que sirve para lanzar módulos añadidos en capítulos posteriores
Aprenda los conceptos y la arquitectura de un conjunto de características específicos, incluyendo vistas, mapas, servicios basados en ubicación, almacenamiento persistente de datos, gráficos 2D y 3D, servicios multimedia, servicios de telefonía y mensajería
Use código de ejemplo listo para funcionar que implemente cada función
Incluir en temas avanzados, como seguridad, vistas personalizadas, análisis de rendimiento e internacionalización

El libro es un complemento natural a la documentación existente de Android proporcionada por Google. Ya sea que desee desarrollar una aplicación comercial para dispositivos móviles, o simplemente desea crear un mashup móvil para uso personal, Android Application Development demuestra cómo puede diseñar, construir y probar aplicaciones para el nuevo mercado móvil.

title: Futureproof
description:
Futureproof paints a complete picture of the major disruptive forces currently facing us - defining them, mapping them out and putting them into context. Covering not just the new technologies, but how they are used and related, this book provides a global view of how to navigate the disruptive forces and use them to your advantage.

Next, discover the 12 Forces that are shaping our world: including the new technologies, how they are used and related, the potential Impact of the disruption and how you can to turn them into enablers for your business.

For each of the Forces, you'll discover:

What is it and why is it disruptive?
What do you need to know now?
What do you need to do next?

The full text downloaded to your computer

With eBooks you can:

search for key concepts, words and phrases
make highlights and notes as you study

title: Office and SharePoint 2007 User's Guide: Integrating SharePoint with Excel, Outlook, Access, and Word
description:
Web sites. Collaboration. Document management. Paperless offices. We want it all in business today, but how do you achieve all of these goals? More importantly, if you work for one of the millions of small to medium-sized businesses, how do you find the time and build the expertise necessary to reach these goals? Even the most powerful tool will not allow you to succeed unless you can get the majority of your staff to use it efficiently and effectively. You need a guide that demonstrates a platform small to medium-sized businesses can use to reach these goals.

Office and SharePoint 2007 User's Guide: Integrating SharePoint with Excel, Outlook, Access and Word demystifies the path every Microsoft Office user can follow to benefit from the synergism of tools they are already familiar with. Together with SharePoint 2007, users can achieve goals like web sites with a consistent single view, improved collaboration within their organization, better document management, and maybe even get one step closer to the paperless office we've been promised for years. This book has topics for Office users of all skill levels, from those just starting to use Office tools to the experienced power user. It examines each major Office tool and shows how it contributes to the support and use of SharePoint in today's increasingly electronic-based office environment.

title: Take Control of iOS & iPadOS Privacy and Security, 2nd Edition
description:
Master networking, privacy, and security for iOS and iPadOS! Version 2.1, updated November 23, 2021

Ensuring that your iPhone or iPad's data remains secure and in your control and that your private data remains private isn't a battle—if you know what boxes to check and how to configure iOS and iPadOS to your advantage. Take Control of iOS & iPadOS Privacy and Security takes you into the intricacies of Apple's choices when it comes to networking, data sharing, and encryption. Updated for iOS 15 and iPadOS 15!

Your iPhone and iPad have become the center of your digital identity, and it’s easy to lose track of all the ways in which Apple and other parties access your data legitimately—or without your full knowledge and consent. While Apple nearly always errs on the side of disclosure and permission, many other firms don’t. This book comprehensively explains how to configure iOS 15 and iPadOS 15 to best protect your privacy while messaging, email, browsing, and much more, and how to ensure your devices and data are secure from intrusion.

Take Control of iOS & iPadOS Privacy and Security covers how to configure the hundreds of privacy and data sharing settings Apple offers in iOS and iPadOS, and which it mediates for thirdparty apps. You’ll learn how Safari has been increasingly hardened to protect your web surfing habits, personal data, and identity—particularly with the addition of the iCloud Private Relay, an option for iCloud+ subscribers to anonymize their Safari browsing.

In addition to privacy and security, this book also teachers you everything you need to know about networking, whether you’re using cellular, WiFi, Bluetooth, or combinations of all of them, as well as about AirDrop, AirPlay, Airplane Mode, and Personal Hotspot and tethering.

You’ll learn how to:

Master all the options for a Personal Hotspot for yourself and in a Family Sharing group.
Troubleshoot problematic WiFi connections.
Set up a device securely from the moment you power up a new or newly restored iPhone or iPad.
Manage Apple’s new builtin second factor verification code generator for extrasecure website and app logins.
Protect your email by using an address Apple manages and relays messages through for you.
Understand Safari’s blocking techniques and how to review websites’ attempts to track you.
Anticipate Apple’s potentially privacychallenging changes designed to improve the safety of children, both those using Apple hardware and those who suffering abuse.
Optimize cellular data use to avoid throttling or overage charges, while always getting the best throughput.
Understand why Apple might ask for your iPhone, iPad, or Mac password when you log in on a new device using twofactor authentication.
Share a WiFi password with nearby contacts and via a QR Code.
Differentiate between encrypted data sessions and endtoend encryption.
Stream music and video to other devices with AirPlay 2.
Deter bruteforce cracking by relying on a USB Accessories timeout.
Configure Bluetooth devices.
Transfer files between iOS and macOS with AirDrop.
Block creeps from iMessage, FaceTime, text messages, and phone calls.
Secure your data in transit with a Virtual Private Network (VPN) connection.
Protect Apple ID account and iCloud data from unwanted access.

title: Securing Windows Server 2003
description:
With the success of computer viruses like Slammer, security issues are now a top priority for Windows system administrators, right alongside day-to-day tasks such as setting up accounts and managing performance. If you use Windows 2003 Server at a small to medium-sized organization, or use Microsoft's Small Business Server, this thorough yet concise tutorial offers the hands-on advice you need for securing your network. Modern network operating systems include bundled services that range from traditional file and print sharing and Internet services to authentication, directory and remote access services each a potential security vulnerability as well as a capability. Securing Windows Server 2003 shows you how to put Windows security tools to work, and how to run the server's subsystems to protect users and resources. But that's just the beginning. Network security needs to be well thought-out, not treated as a fire drill when a threat occurs. This book focuses primarily on ways to plan and implement a secure operating environment. Microsoft security veteran Mike Danseglio uses real-world examples to show you how various security concepts relate to your own system, including:

File System Security

Group Policy and security templates

Running secure code

Authentication

IP security

Public Key Certificates and Public Key Infrastructure

Smart Card technology

DHCP and DNS security

Internet Information Services security

Active Directory security

Remote access security

Security audits

Sending secure email, and more

Many chapters include a debate, in which fictional protagonists discuss the pros and cons of a particular strategy or solution. These debates provide an objective look at competing methodologies, so you can select the solutions that best fit your network. Read this book cover to cover to create and implement a security plan, or use individual chapters as stand-alone lessons. Either way, Securing Windows Server 2003 will guide you safely through the morass of security threats.

Si utiliza Windows 2003 Server en una organización pequeña a mediana, o utiliza el Servidor de Pequeñas Empresas de Microsoft, este tutorial minucioso pero conciso ofrece el consejo práctico que necesita para asegurar su red. Los sistemas operativos modernos de red incluyen servicios agrupados que van desde el uso tradicional de archivos e impresiones y servicios de Internet a servicios de autenticación, directorio y acceso remoto cada uno de una posible vulnerabilidad de seguridad, así como una capacidad. Garantizar Windows Server 2003 le muestra cómo poner las herramientas de seguridad de Windows para funcionar, y cómo ejecutar los subsistemas del servidor para proteger a los usuarios y recursos. Pero eso es sólo el principio. La seguridad de la red debe ser bien pensada, no tratada como un simulacro de incendio cuando se produce una amenaza. Este libro se centra principalmente en formas de planificar e implementar un entorno operativo seguro. El veterano de seguridad de Microsoft Mike Danseglio utiliza ejemplos del mundo real para mostrarle cómo diversos conceptos de seguridad se relacionan con su propio sistema, incluyendo:

De cualquier manera, Securing Windows Server 2003 le guiará de forma segura a través de las amenazas de seguridad.

title: Test-Driven iOS Development with Swift 4 - Third Edition

description:

title: Beginning ARKit for iPhone and iPad: Augmented Reality App Development for iOS
description:
Explore how to use ARKit to create iOS apps and learn the basics of augmented reality while diving into ARKit specific topics. This book reveals how augmented reality allows you to view the screen on an iOS device, aim the camera at a nearby scene, and view both the real items in that scene as well as a graphic image overlaid on to that scene. 

You’ll start by accessing the camera and teaching your app to track the world around its device. You'll then see how to position nodes and create augmented reality shapes and textures. Next you’ll have your creations interact with their environment by programming workable physics, detecting planes, measuring distance, and applying virtual force. Finally you’ll learn how to hit test and troubleshoot your applications to ensure they interact with the real world around them seamlessly.

ARKit is Apple’s software framework for creating augmented reality apps on iOS devices such as the iPhone and iPad. Unlike virtual reality that creates an entirely artificial world for the user to view and explore, Beginning ARKit for iPhone and iPad will show you how augmented reality places artificial items in an actual scene displayed by an iOS device’s camera.  

What You’ll Learn

Access the camera
Use ARKit’s hit testing for tracked geometry
Apply and combine real world and virtual physics

Who This Book Is For

Programmers familiar with the basics of Swift programming who want to dive into developing iOS applications with Swift.
translatedDescription:
Explore cómo utilizar ARKit para crear aplicaciones iOS y aprender los fundamentos de la realidad aumentada mientras bucea en temas específicos de ARKit. Este libro revela cómo la realidad aumentada le permite ver la pantalla en un dispositivo iOS, apuntar a la cámara en una escena cercana, y ver tanto los elementos reales en esa escena como una imagen gráfica superpuesta a esa escena.

Comenzarás accediendo a la cámara y enseñando tu aplicación para rastrear el mundo alrededor de su dispositivo. Verás cómo colocar los nodos y crear formas y texturas de realidad aumentadas. A continuación, tendrá sus creaciones interactúan con su entorno mediante la programación de la física viable, la detección de planos, la medición de distancia y la aplicación de la fuerza virtual. Finalmente aprenderás a probar y resolver problemas tus aplicaciones para asegurar que interactúen con el mundo real alrededor de ellos sin problemas.

ARKit es el marco de software de Apple para crear aplicaciones de realidad aumentada en dispositivos iOS como el iPhone y el iPad. A diferencia de la realidad virtual que crea un mundo totalmente artificial para que el usuario vea y explore, Beginning ARKit para iPhone y iPad le mostrará cómo la realidad aumentada coloca elementos artificiales en una escena real mostrada por la cámara de un dispositivo iOS.

Lo que aprenderás

Accede a la cámara
Usar las pruebas de éxito de ARKit para geometría rastreada
Aplicar y combinar el mundo real y la física virtual

Quién es este libro

Los programadores conocen los fundamentos de la programación Swift que quieren sumergirse en el desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS con Swift.

Discover how Visual Studio 2019 can improve your development process. 

Visual Studio is an integral part of the daily life of millions of developers worldwide. Even as this rich integrated development environment approaches two decades, it has never ceased in innovating ways to make developers’ work life more productive.

Essential Visual Studio 2019 offers explicit guidance for the developer who is already familiar with Visual Studio, but might feel a little lost when it comes to understanding the more recent features and advances of the IDE. Busy developers simply don’t have the time to digest and distill what the latest and greatest tools are with each version. As a result, useful process and performance features may be overlooked. This book, by simply focusing on the most recent innovations in Visual Studio and its tangential developer market, is the perfect "go to" for bridging that gap.

Be ready to plunge headfirst into key features andadvances that have been added, expanded, or improved, and topics such as unit testing, refactoring, Git, debugging, containers, and more. You will procure the basic concepts and value first, before diving into hands-on code that is designed to quickly get you up and running.

The goal of this book is to bring the developer up to speed on Visual Studio 2019. It does not focus just on functionality added in Visual Studio 2019, but takes a deep dive into the areas where Visual Studio 2019 changed. That way, even if you’re coming from much earlier versions of Visual Studio, you can easily discern how upgrading to Visual Studio 2019 can make you more productive.

title: Programming Mobile Devices: An Introduction for Practitioners
description:
With forewords by Jan Bosch, Nokia and Antero Taivalsaari, Sun Microsystems.

Learn how to programme the mobile devices of the future!

The importance of mobile systems programming has emerged over the recent years as a new domain in software development. The design of software that runs in a mobile device requires that developers combine the rules applicable in embedded environment; memory-awareness, limited performance, security, and limited resources with features that are needed in workstation environment; modifiability, run-time extensions, and rapid application development.

Programming Mobile Devices is a comprehensive, practical introduction to programming mobile systems. The book is a platform independent approach to programming mobile devices: it does not focus on specific technologies, and devices, instead it evaluates the component areas and issues that are common to all mobile software platforms. This text will enable the designer to programme mobile devices by mastering both hardware-aware and application-level software, as well as the main principles that guide their design.

Programming Mobile Devices:

Provides a complete and authoritative overview of programming mobile systems.

Discusses the major issues surrounding mobile systems programming; such as understanding of embedded systems and workstation programming.

Covers memory management, the concepts of applications, dynamically linked libraries, concurrency, handling local resources, networking and mobile devices as well as security features.

Uses generic examples from JavaTM and Symbian OS to illustrate the principles of mobile device programming.

Programming Mobile Devices is essential reading for graduate and advanced undergraduate students, academic and industrial researchers in the field as well as software developers, and programmers.
translatedDescription:
Con prefacio de Jan Bosch, Nokia y Antero Taivalsaari, Sun Microsystems.

¡Aprenda a programar los dispositivos móviles del futuro!

La importancia de la programación de sistemas móviles ha surgido en los últimos años como un nuevo dominio en el desarrollo de software. El diseño de software que se ejecuta en un dispositivo móvil requiere que los desarrolladores combinen las reglas aplicables en entorno incrustado; conciencia de memoria, rendimiento limitado, seguridad y recursos limitados con características que se necesitan en entorno de estación de trabajo; modificabilidad, extensiones de tiempo de ejecución y desarrollo rápido de aplicaciones.

Programación de dispositivos móviles es una introducción completa y práctica a la programación de sistemas móviles. El libro es un enfoque independiente de la plataforma para la programación de dispositivos móviles: no se centra en tecnologías específicas y dispositivos, sino que evalúa las áreas de componentes y cuestiones que son comunes a todas las plataformas de software móvil. Este texto permitirá al diseñador programar dispositivos móviles dominando tanto el software de hardware como el software de aplicación, así como los principios principales que guían su diseño.

Programación de dispositivos móviles:

Proporciona un panorama completo y autorizado de los sistemas móviles de programación.

Divulga las principales cuestiones relacionadas con la programación de sistemas móviles; como la comprensión de sistemas integrados y la programación de estaciones de trabajo.

Cubre la gestión de la memoria, los conceptos de aplicaciones, bibliotecas vinculadas dinámicamente, concurrencia, manejo de recursos locales, redes y dispositivos móviles, así como funciones de seguridad.

Utiliza ejemplos genéricos de JavaTM y Symbian OS para ilustrar los principios de programación de dispositivos móviles.

Programación de dispositivos móviles es la lectura esencial para estudiantes de posgrado y avanzados, investigadores académicos e industriales en el campo, así como desarrolladores de software, y programadores.

The SharePoint 2007 family (consisting of Windows SharePoint Service 3.0 and Microsoft Office SharePoint Server 2007) build upon these features and toolsets and introduce a staggering array of new tools and capabilities that undeniably make SharePoint 2007 an enterprise-class solution.

title: Mobile Electronic Commerce
description:
Mobile commerce transactions continue to soar, driven largely by the ever-increasing adoption and use of smartphones and tablets. The use of this technology gives consumers the flexibility to shop whenever and wherever they want. Mobile Electronic Commerce: Foundations, Development, and Applications addresses the role of industry, academia, scientists, engineers, professionals, and students in developing innovative new mobile commerce technologies and systems to further improve the consumer experience. It also discusses the impact of mobile commerce on society, economics, culture, organizations, government, industry, and our daily lives.

This book brings together experts from multiple disciplines in industry and academia to stimulate new thinking in the development and application of mobile commerce technology. The book covers important mobile commerce topics, such as critical infrastructure management, mobile security issues, new applications and services, emerging development architectures, mobile business solutions, and future research opportunities.

In addition to its multidisciplinary approach, the book also provides a cross-cultural approach intended to overcome cultural barriers and accelerate mobile commerce advancement in the global economy. Authors and researchers from around the world discuss a broad spectrum of methods, tools, and guidelines for designing mobile commerce systems and services in different cultures.

Las transacciones de comercio móvil siguen aumentando, impulsadas en gran medida por la adopción y el uso cada vez mayores de teléfonos inteligentes y tabletas. El uso de esta tecnología da a los consumidores la flexibilidad para comprar siempre y cuando quiera. Comercio Electrónico Móvil: Fundaciones, Desarrollo y Aplicaciones aborda el papel de la industria, academias, científicos, ingenieros, profesionales y estudiantes en el desarrollo de nuevas tecnologías y sistemas de comercio móvil innovadores para mejorar aún más la experiencia del consumidor. También analiza el impacto del comercio móvil en la sociedad, la economía, la cultura, las organizaciones, el gobierno, la industria y nuestra vida cotidiana.

Este libro reúne a expertos de múltiples disciplinas en la industria y el mundo académico para estimular el nuevo pensamiento en el desarrollo y aplicación de la tecnología de comercio móvil. El libro abarca importantes temas de comercio móvil, como la gestión de infraestructuras críticas, cuestiones de seguridad móvil, nuevas aplicaciones y servicios, nuevas arquitecturas de desarrollo emergentes, soluciones de negocios móviles y futuras oportunidades de investigación.

Además de su enfoque multidisciplinario, el libro también ofrece un enfoque intercultural destinado a superar las barreras culturales y acelerar el avance del comercio móvil en la economía mundial. Autores e investigadores de todo el mundo discuten un amplio espectro de métodos, herramientas y directrices para diseñar sistemas y servicios de comercio móvil en diferentes culturas.

Con más de tres años de experiencia trabajando con Whistler en las implementaciones tempranas de beta y producción, los autores de este libro han proporcionado un recurso para ayudarle a que las tecnologías de Windows 2003 funcionen correctamente.

Cuando se le da una selección de diferentes maneras de implementar las tecnologías, puede dirigirse a este libro para las mejores prácticas de implementaciones de campo exitosas. Este libro se organiza en ocho partes centrándose en un área de solución tecnológica básica, con varios capítulos conformando cada parte. Las secciones incluyen seguridad, gestión, diseño, migración, continuidad de las operaciones, rendimiento y productividad de las empresas.

title: Computer Support for Successful Project Management
description: In the recent past, computer programs have been used extensively to manage construction projects. It has become almost mandatory for construction managers and civil engineering students to learn how to use computer software to manage projects using computer software. Computer Support for Successful Project Management: Using MS Project 2016 with Construction Projects is a book intended to help construction management professionals and civil engineering students in using popular software MS-Project. Although there are many books on MS-Project, there are very few that cover the subject from the construction managers’ perspective. This book uses guided examples from the construction sector. Most of the relevant project management terminology, concepts, and key processes have also been discussed, based on the standards of the Project Management Institute. This book will help construction project managers to easily relate with the projects they execute in their day-to-day life. The author has included advanced topics like earned value analysis and multiple project management. Readers will also learn how a tool like MS-Project can be used for processes related to risk and quality, in addition to meeting project objectives like scope, time, and cost. This book will help readers transform from a construction professional to a construction project manager.

Apoyo informático para la gestión exitosa de proyectos: el uso de MS Project 2016 con proyectos de construcción es un libro destinado a ayudar a profesionales de la gestión de la construcción y estudiantes de ingeniería civil a utilizar el software popular MS-Project. Aunque hay muchos libros sobre MS-Project, hay muy pocos que cubren el tema desde la perspectiva de los administradores de la construcción. Este libro utiliza ejemplos guiados del sector de la construcción. También se han examinado la mayor parte de la terminología, los conceptos y los procesos clave de gestión de proyectos pertinentes, sobre la base de las normas del Instituto de Gestión de Proyectos. Este libro ayudará a los directores de proyectos de construcción a relacionarse fácilmente con los proyectos que ejecutan en su vida cotidiana. El autor ha incluido temas avanzados como análisis de valor ganado y gestión de proyectos múltiples. Los lectores también aprenderán cómo se puede utilizar una herramienta como MS-Project para procesos relacionados con el riesgo y la calidad, además de cumplir objetivos de proyecto como el alcance, el tiempo y el costo. Este libro ayudará a los lectores a transformar de un profesional de la construcción a un gerente de proyecto de construcción.

title: PalmPilot: The Ultimate Guide, Second Edition
description:
3Com's PalmPilot is the world's bestselling hand-held computer platform. In three years, its 16 models from 5 different manufacturers have captured 80 percent of the palmtop market. About the size of a playing card, Palm devices are lightweight (under 6 ounces), offering two-month battery life, handwriting recognition, Internet connectivity, and a touch-screen display. Above all, these devices are fast and elegantly designed. PalmPilot: The Ultimate Guide was an instant classic when it debuted in 1998, becoming, and remaining, the bestselling Palm book (and a top ten title among all computer books) every month since. Dense with previously undocumented information, this newly updated bible for Palm users delivers hundreds of timesaving tips and surprising tricks, plus a CD-ROM containing over 3,100 Palm programs. The second edition offers exclusive insider coverage of all models, including 1999's Palm IIIx, Palm V, laser-equipped Symbol 1500, and the revolutionary, wireless Palm VII. The book is divided into five sections:

Section One details every hardware and software aspect of PalmPilot as it comes out of the box: the stylus and screen, the buttons, and the current line of models. A tutorial takes the reader through the palmtop's preferences and settings panels, teaches the Graffiti alphabet, and unearths surprising features of the machine's eight built-in programs.

Section Two explains step-by-step how your PalmPilot can work with your PC: how data gets from your palmtop to your desktop computer and back again (HotSyncing). New chapters give special coverage to the separate Windows and Macintosh (Mac Pac 2.0) versions of Palm Desktop, which duplicates the functions of the PalmPilot (calendar, phone book, to-do list, memo pad, email, and expense tracking) on the desktop machine.

Section Three takes the reader beyond the built-in Palm software to the best of the add-on programs included with the book. They include such graphics programs as DinkyPad, TealPaint, and the amazing ImageViewer (which unlocks the "black-and-white" Pilot screen's grayscale features); electronic books in Doc format; and music programs that use the hand-held's built-in speaker. New in this edition: how-to advice for using PalmPilot database programs to collect data in the field, and syncing them with such popular PC programs as FileMaker and Microsoft Access.

Section Four covers the new Palm VII, the first one-piece, pocket-sized, wireless Internet device ever marketed, offering cell-network-based email and Web access anywhere in the country. As this section makes clear, any PalmPilot model can access the Net when equipped with the tiny PalmPilot modem. Such an arrangement is ideal for reading and replying to email--a great time-shifter for anyone who'd otherwise consider plane, train, or automobile time as downtime. Additional chapters cover the five Palm Web browsers, paging, faxing, and infrared beaming features.

Section Five explains simple ways to troubleshoot both software and hardware, including HotSync snafus and various software glitches. Special chapters cover Palm fans' options for upgrading and accessorizing their palmtops. Two new appendixes debut in this edition; one explains how to write Palm VII Web-querying applets; the other, for the first time, covers the PalmPilot's synergy with Unix and Linux machines.

PalmPilot: The Ultimate Guide, 2nd Edition is the most comprehensive Palm-platform book yet written. With the cooperation of Palm Computing, and 3Com, bestselling computer-book author David Pogue succinctly answers every conceivable question, unlocks Palm features most users never suspected, and radiates the fun, passion, and sense of community shared by Piloteers the world over. The enclosed CD-ROM (for Windows 9x, NT, and the Macintosh) is a disc-based version of the #1 Palm-software Web site, palmcentral.com, offering over 3,100 programs organized in a searchable, sortable database catalog with auto-install features and web links. PalmPilot: The Ultimate Guide is the essential guide for the PalmPilot owner.

La sección Cuatro cubre el nuevo Palm VII, el primer dispositivo de Internet inalámbrico de una sola pieza que se comercializa, que ofrece un email basado en la red celular y acceso a Internet en cualquier lugar del país. Tal acuerdo es ideal para leer y responder al correo electrónico: un gran cambio de tiempo para cualquiera que de otro modo consideraría el tiempo de avión, tren o automóvil como tiempo de inactividad. Los capítulos adicionales cubren los cinco navegadores de Palm Web, paging, fax y funciones de rayos infrarrojos.

La sección Cinco explica formas sencillas de solucionar problemas tanto software como hardware, incluyendo HotSync snafus y varios fallos de software. Los capítulos especiales cubren las opciones de los aficionados de palma para actualizar y accesorizar sus palmas. Dos nuevos apéndices debutan en esta edición; uno explica cómo escribir Palm VII Web-querying applets; el otro, por primera vez, cubre la sinergia de PalmPilot con máquinas Unix y Linux.

PalmPilot: The Ultimate Guide, 2nd Edition es el libro más completo de Palm-platform aún escrito. Con la cooperación de Palm Computing, y 3Com, el autor bestseller de computación David Pogue responde sucintamente a cada pregunta concebible, desbloquea las características de Palm la mayoría de los usuarios nunca sospechados, y irradia la diversión, pasión y sentido de la comunidad compartido por Piloteers el mundo entero. El CD-ROM adjunto (para Windows 9x, NT y Macintosh) es una versión basada en discos del sitio web #1 Palm-software, palmcentral.com, que ofrece más de 3.100 programas organizados en un catálogo de bases de datos de búsqueda y clasificable con funciones de instalación automática y enlaces web. PalmPilot: La Guía Última es la guía esencial para el propietario de PalmPilot.

title: Pro Exchange Server 2013 Administration
description:

Author Jaap Wesselius is at your side as you administer every facet of Exchange Server 2013, revealing tips, tricks, and little known facts that will make your administration life simpler and more effective. Additionally, this guide covers the tools and techniques for monitoring an Exchange environment and troubleshooting when things go wrong.

With Pro Exchange Server 2013 Administration, you will:

Learn how to install Exchange Server fresh or upgrade from a previous version

Get a comprehensive understanding of Exchange, with thorough coverage of Mailbox server and Client Access server

Learn how to monitor your deployment and prepare for any problems and how to troubleshoot any problems that do arise

A comprehensive set of best practices for administering Exchange Server 2013 on a daily basis.

A thorough understanding of new features.

How to design and deploy new Exchange 2013 servers and upgrade existing Exchange servers to Exchange 2013.

Understand the differences and similarities between Exchange on-premise and Exchange Online.

Who this book is for

Pro Exchange Server 2013 Administration is intended for mail system administrators and architects who design, deploy, and support messaging infrastructures that include Microsoft Exchange.

title: Simplicity in the Details: Designing Faster Web and Mobile Interactions
description: It’s the tiny details that delight customers. Creating an exceptional interface, whether it’s for a web page, an app, or even products like bank ATMs, leads to loyal customers and word of mouth recommendations. This guide by UX design leader, Giles Colborne, focuses on how to create extraordinarily simple interfaces by paying attention to the details. Complementing his book Simple and Usable Web, Mobile, and Interaction Design, Giles offers practical advice on how to create better web and mobile interactions. • Explore how to make interfaces that are effective, efficient, and satisfying • Learn from abundant examples of successful designs • Get concrete time limits for specific website tasks • Consider when perceived efficiency, in addition to real efficiency, is advantageous for users • Gain insight into measuring customer satisfaction • Find out why it’s important to understand your users and how to go about it • Learn to balance avoiding errors with streamlined communication (in other words, how not to treat users like idiots) • Anticipate users’ needs without bogging them down • Get tips on working with different types of users, including those who are error prone Author bio: Giles Colborne has worked in usability and user-centered design since 1991 beginning at British Aerospace. He developed some of the first online publications at Institute of Physics Publishing in the early 1990s and worked on numerous international websites before founding cxpartners with Richard Caddick in 2004. cxpartners now works with companies worldwide to create web and mobile user experiences that are used by tens of millions of people. Giles is a former President of the UK Usability Professionals’ Association, co-chair of IA Summit and has worked with British Standards Institute in developing guidance on web accessibility. His first book, Simple and Usable: web mobile and interaction design is published by New Riders and has been translated into Chinese and Korean.

Esta guía del líder de diseño UX, Giles Colborne, se centra en cómo crear interfaces extraordinariamente sencillas prestando atención a los detalles. Complementando su libro Simple y Usable Web, Mobile y Interaction Design, Giles ofrece consejos prácticos sobre cómo crear mejores interacciones web y móviles. • Descubra cómo hacer interfaces eficaces, eficientes y satisfactorias • Aprenda de ejemplos abundantes de diseños exitosos • Obtenga límites de tiempo concretos para tareas específicas del sitio web • Considere cuando se percibe la eficiencia, además de la eficiencia real, es ventajoso para los usuarios • Obtenga información sobre la satisfacción del cliente • Descubra por qué es importante entender a sus usuarios y cómo hacerlo • Aprenda a equilibrar los errores de comunicación simplificada (en otras palabras, cómo no tratarlos). Desarrolló algunas de las primeras publicaciones en línea en Institute of Physics Publishing a principios del decenio de 1990 y trabajó en numerosos sitios web internacionales antes de fundar cxpartners con Richard Caddick en 2004. cxpartners ahora trabaja con empresas de todo el mundo para crear experiencias de usuario web y móvil que son utilizadas por decenas de millones de personas. Giles es un ex presidente de la Asociación de Profesionales de la Usabilidad del Reino Unido, copresidente de la Cumbre de IA y ha colaborado con el Instituto de Normas Británicas en la elaboración de orientaciones sobre accesibilidad web. title: Efficient Android Threading
description:

This practical book describes many asynchronous mechanisms available in the Android SDK, and provides guidelines for selecting the ones most appropriate for the app you’re building.

Author Anders Goransson demonstrates the advantages and disadvantages of each technique, with sample code and detailed explanations for using it efficiently. The first part of the book describes the building blocks of asynchronous processing, and the second part covers Android libraries and constructs for developing fast, responsive, and well-structured apps.

Understand multithreading basics in Java and on the Android platform

Use strategies to reduce the risk of memory leaks

Use Java’s Executor Framework to control or cancel threads
Handle background task execution with AsyncTask and IntentService
Access content providers with AsyncQueryHandler
Use loaders to update the UI with new data

title: iOS 14 Programming for Beginners - Fifth Edition
description:
Dive into creating iOS applications with 'iOS 14 Programming for Beginners.' This guide, tailored for programming novices eager to explore iOS development, uses Swift 5.3 and Xcode 12 to teach you how to build, test, and publish iOS apps. Along the way, you'll learn practical app-building skills incorporating the latest iOS 14 features, such as widgets and App Clips.

What this Book will help me do

Master Swift 5.3 fundamentals and learn iOS development using Xcode 12.
Build functional iOS applications with user-friendly interfaces.
Harness iOS 14 features, including widgets, SwiftUI, and App Clips.
Implement advanced programming practices like the MVC design pattern.
Learn to publish your apps on the App Store and reach your audience.

Author(s)

Ahmad Sahar is an experienced software developer with years of expertise in iOS application development. Through his insightful teaching style and up-to-date technical knowledge, he simplifies complex topics for new developers. Ahmad's passion for programming education stems from his dedication to helping others enter the exciting world of iOS app development.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for software developers and programming enthusiasts with basic programming skills looking to start their journey with iOS app development. If you've been curious about app creation or want to transition to Swift and iOS platforms, this book will guide you effectively. With plenty of hands-on examples, it suits learners eager to see tangible results quickly.

Sumérgete en crear aplicaciones iOS con 'iOS 14 Programación para principiantes.' Esta guía, adaptada para novatos de programación ansiosos de explorar el desarrollo de iOS, utiliza Swift 5.3 y Xcode 12 para enseñarte a crear, probar y publicar aplicaciones iOS. A lo largo del camino, usted aprenderá habilidades prácticas de creación de aplicaciones que incorporan las últimas características de iOS 14, tales como widgets y App Clips.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Master Swift 5.3 fundamentales y aprender el desarrollo de iOS usando Xcode 12.
Construir aplicaciones iOS funcionales con interfaces fáciles de usar.
Harness iOS 14 características, incluyendo widgets, SwiftUI y App Clips.
Implementar prácticas de programación avanzadas como el patrón de diseño MVC.
Aprende a publicar tus aplicaciones en App Store y llega a tu audiencia.

Autor(s)

Ahmad Sahar es un desarrollador de software experimentado con años de experiencia en el desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS. A través de su perspicaz estilo de enseñanza y conocimientos técnicos actualizados, simplifica temas complejos para los nuevos desarrolladores. La pasión de Ahmad por la educación de programación deriva de su dedicación para ayudar a otros a entrar en el mundo emocionante del desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para desarrolladores de software y entusiastas de programación con habilidades básicas de programación que buscan iniciar su viaje con el desarrollo de aplicaciones iOS. Si usted ha tenido curiosidad sobre la creación de aplicaciones o desea la transición a plataformas Swift e iOS, este libro le guiará eficazmente. Con un montón de ejemplos prácticos, se adapta a los estudiantes deseosos de ver resultados tangibles rápidamente.

title: Creating Dynamic UI with Android Fragments
description:
Creating Dynamic UI with Android Fragments is your practical guide to delivering engaging and adaptable user interfaces in your Android applications. By mastering the fragment model in Android, you will be able to create UIs that are both feature-rich and responsive across a wide variety of device configurations.

What this Book will help me do

Understand how to implement fragments for modular UI design in Android applications.
Effectively use fragment transactions to dynamically manage UI elements.
Learn to create layouts that adapt for a seamless experience on smartphones and tablets.
Incorporate advanced navigation behaviors such as swipe-based transitions.
Master handling fragment lifecycles for a stable and efficient app design.

Author(s)

Jim Wilson is an experienced Android developer and trainer who has spent years in the industry helping developers improve their skills. With a passion for creating amazing user experiences, Jim has condensed his expertise into this hands-on guide. His tutorials are known for their clarity and real-world applicability.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for developers with a basic understanding of Android programming who want to take their UI design skills to the next level. Whether you're seeking to create more dynamic interfaces or better support multiple screen sizes, this guide will provide the knowledge you need.

Al dominar el modelo de fragmento en Android, usted será capaz de crear UIs que son ricos en características y sensibles a través de una amplia variedad de configuraciones de dispositivos.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender cómo implementar fragmentos para el diseño modular de interfaz de usuario en aplicaciones Android.
Utilizar de manera eficaz las transacciones fragmentarias para gestionar dinámicamente los elementos de la interfaz de usuario.
Aprende a crear diseños que se adapten a una experiencia perfecta en smartphones y tabletas.
Incorporar comportamientos avanzados de navegación tales como transiciones basadas en el giro.
Manejo maestro ciclos de vida de fragmentos para un diseño de aplicaciones estable y eficiente.

Autor(s)

Jim Wilson es un desarrollador y entrenador Android experimentado que ha pasado años en la industria ayudando a los desarrolladores a mejorar sus habilidades. Este libro es perfecto para los desarrolladores con una comprensión básica de la programación Android que quieren llevar sus habilidades de diseño de la interfaz de usuario al siguiente nivel. Si busca crear interfaces más dinámicas o apoyar mejor múltiples tamaños de pantalla, esta guía proporcionará el conocimiento que necesita.

title: PlayStation Mobile Development Cookbook
description:
"PlayStation Mobile Development Cookbook" is your comprehensive guide to building captivating games and applications for PlayStation Vita and PlayStation-Certified devices. Through practical recipes, you'll learn to use the PlayStation Mobile SDK to effortlessly create both 2D and 3D interactive content, mastering input methods, graphics, audio, and networking to craft immersive experiences.

What this Book will help me do

Develop and animate sprites for functional and appealing 2D games.
Leverage the GameEngine 2D library to optimize your development process.
Implement realistic physics and enhance gameplay dynamics.
Create and manage interactive 3D environments using advanced modeling and shading techniques.
Enable multiplayer functionality to enhance user experiences with competitive and cooperative modes.

Author(s)

Michael Fleischauer, the author of this book, is a seasoned developer with extensive experience in PlayStation Mobile development. Through his passion for teaching, he presents clear and actionable insights into SDK features, empowering developers to create cutting-edge applications for PlayStation platforms.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for developers with basic C programming skills who aspire to build compelling applications for PlayStation Vita and PlayStation-Certified devices. It caters to individuals who wish to expand their expertise into game development while exploring PlayStation Mobile's unique capabilities. If you're enthusiastic about creating interactive entertainment, this book is for you.

title: Enterprise Content Management with Microsoft SharePoint

Led by two ECM experts, you’ll learn how to build a solid information architecture (IA) for managing documents, knowledge, web content, digital assets, records, and user-generated content throughout your organization. With examples and case studies based on the authors’ real-world experience, this practical book is ideal for CIOs, marketing executives, project managers, and enterprise architects.

Discover how to:

Design a scalable, easy-to-use content management repository
Build an ECM team with specific project governance roles
Gain stakeholder support for project and change management
Foster user adoption by clarifying general IA concepts
Organize content using SharePoint records management tools
Configure content types, managed metadata, and site settings
Examine processes for managing paper-driven vs. digital content
Apply best practices for deploying SharePoint ECM features
Support risk management and compliance regulations

title: Mastering iOS Frameworks: Beyond the Basics, Second Edition
description:
Apple’s iOS SDK provides an amazingly powerful collection of frameworks. But it has been difficult to find detailed and useful knowledge about them–until now. With this book’s practical insights and tested code, you can use Apple’s frameworks to create apps that are more innovative and usable…faster and more reliable…more successful and profitable.

Kyle Richter and Joe Keeley focus on intermediate-to-advanced techniques that professional iOS developers can use every day. Their far-reaching coverage ranges from social support to security, Core Data to iCloud–even Apple Watch.

Organized as a convenient modular reference, nearly every chapter contains a complete Objective-C sample project. A multi-chapter Game Center case study shows how multiple iOS features can be combined to do even more.

All source code may be downloaded athttps://github.com/dfsw/icf.

Coverage includes:

Adding physics-like animation and behaviors to UIViews

Using Core Location to determine device location, display customized maps, and implement geofencing

Making games and apps social with Leaderboards

Accessing music and image collections

Building health/fitness apps with HealthKit

Integrating with home automation via HomeKit

Passing data between platforms using JSON

Setting up local and remote notifications

Remotely storing and syncing data with CloudKit

Accessing app functionality with extensions

Effortlessly adding AirPrint support

Providing Handoff continuity between iOS 8 and Yosemite devices

Getting productive with Core Data

Integrating Twitter and Facebook via Social Framework

Performing resource-intensive tasks with Grand Central Dispatch

Securing user data with Keychain and Touch ID

Customizing collection views

Making the most of gesture recognizers

Creating and distributing “passes”

Debugging, instrumenting, and profiling apps
